description: This file defines the 'LoraProvider' interface for a LoRaWAN device provider in a Java project. It declares methods for extracting message details, accepted content types, and sending downlink commands, serving as a contract for implementations that handle LoRa messages.

classes.name: LoraProvider
classes.description: A Java interface defining methods for a LoRaWAN device provider, including message extraction, content negotiation, and command sending functionalities.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the LoRaWAN provider, used for identifying the provider in messages.

methods.name: pathPrefix
methods.description: Returns the URL path prefix for this provider, e.g., '/myloraprovider'.

methods.name: extractMessageType
methods.description: Extracts the message type from an incoming LoRa message, defaults to UPLINK.

methods.name: acceptedContentType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type accepted by this provider, default is 'application/json'.

methods.name: acceptedHttpMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method accepted, default is POST.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Abstract method to extract the device ID from a message; throws exception if extraction fails.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Abstract method to extract the payload from a message; throws exception if extraction fails.

methods.name: extractNormalizedData
methods.description: Optional method to extract normalized data as a map from a message, default returns null.

methods.name: extractAdditionalData
methods.description: Optional method to extract additional data as JsonObject, default returns null.

methods.name: sendDownlinkCommand
methods.description: Default method to send a downlink command, with a default implementation that fails the Future, meant to be overridden.
